name: promela-tree-sitter-wasm-lab
description: Self-contained ProMeLa Tree-sitter grammar and TypeScript WASM language-service prototype

scripts.test: npm run build:wasm && npm run build && npm run test:grammar && npm run test:unit
scripts.audit: npm run check:wasm && npm run build && node dist/src/audit.js
scripts.audit:strict: npm run check:wasm && npm run build && node dist/src/audit.js --strict
scripts.test:compiled: npm run check:wasm && npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.stage:core: npm run check:wasm && npm run build && node scripts/stage-core.mjs
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:grammar && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-scripts.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:wasm && npm run build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:negative: npm run check:wasm && npm run build && node --test dist/test/negative.test.js
